tokens.name: color-paper
tokens.usage: Page background, the scratch sheet. Default ground for all text tokens.

tokens.name: color-sheet
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, posts, feedback items, inputs, menus.

tokens.name: color-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a sheet: the 'what feedback I want' panel, quoted text, disabled controls.

tokens.name: color-rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines that only separate (card borders, dividers, the header's bottom edge). Never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: color-rule-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons and the empty answer slot; 3:1 or more on paper and sheet in both themes.

tokens.name: color-ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on paper, sheet, sunken, every *-soft tint and both marker tints.

tokens.name: color-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata (names, dates, stage), hints and placeholders, on paper, sheet, sunken and brand-soft. 4.5:1 or more.

tokens.name: color-brand
tokens.usage: The logo's ballpoint blue. Primary button fill, current-page underline, selected segment. As text only at 19px bold or larger.

tokens.name: color-brand-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and pressed fill.

tokens.name: color-on-brand
tokens.usage: Label and icon on a brand fill (4.52:1 light, 6.98:1 dark).

tokens.name: color-link
tokens.usage: Links and the Public badge text, on paper, sheet, sunken and brand-soft.

tokens.name: color-brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind link-coloured text: the Public badge, the selected response segment.

tokens.name: color-marker
tokens.usage: Highlighter. Only for an open loop (the 'awaiting response' chip, the empty answer slot) and one word in a page hero.

tokens.name: color-marker-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon on color-marker.

tokens.name: color-marker-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger highlighter for the overdue chip. Overdue is a fact, never an alarm: no red.

tokens.name: color-marker-strong-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon on color-marker-strong.

tokens.name: color-accepted
tokens.usage: Accepted answer tag text and icon, on accepted-soft, sheet or paper.

tokens.name: color-accepted-soft
tokens.usage: Accepted answer tag background.

tokens.name: color-rejected
tokens.usage: Rejected answer tag text and icon, on rejected-soft, sheet or paper. Graphite, not red: a reasoned no is a full answer.

tokens.name: color-rejected-soft
tokens.usage: Rejected answer tag background.

tokens.name: color-testing
tokens.usage: Testing answer tag text and icon (copying-pencil violet), on testing-soft, sheet or paper.

tokens.name: color-testing-soft
tokens.usage: Testing answer tag background.

tokens.name: color-danger
tokens.usage: System errors and field validation only, on danger-soft, sheet or paper. Never for a person's answer or an overdue item.

tokens.name: color-danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error message background.

tokens.name: color-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 3.9:1 or more on paper, sheet and sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: color-rail
tokens.usage: The notebook margin line that the project timeline hangs from. Decorative; entries carry their own icon and words.

tokens.name: color-logo
tokens.usage: The logo mark's W. Identical in both themes; never recoloured.

tokens.name: color-logo-eye
tokens.usage: The white of the logo's eye, in both themes.

tokens.name: color-logo-pupil
tokens.usage: The logo's pupil, in both themes.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page at most: the home hero and the sign-in title. Below 640px use title-1's size.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Page title: project name, member name, page heading.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Card titles, post section labels, form legends.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: این نسخه هنوز زشت است و خودم هم مطمئن نیستم.
styles.usage: The one-liner under a page title; the hero's paragraph.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: تعریف الکی به کسی کمک نمی‌کند. اگر چیزی کار نمی‌کند، می‌گوییم.
styles.usage: All running text: posts, feedback, answers, replies. Keep lines under 42rem (container-read).

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Names in bylines, button labels, emphasis. Persian has no italics: emphasise with weight.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Metadata: dates, stage, owners, hints under fields.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, chips, badges, tabs. 13px is the Persian floor: nothing smaller.

styles.name: display-en
styles.usage: English rendering of display: same size and weight, tighter line height.

styles.name: title-1-en
styles.usage: English rendering of title-1: same size and weight, tighter line height.

styles.name: title-2-en
styles.usage: English rendering of title-2: same size and weight, tighter line height.

styles.name: title-3-en
styles.usage: English rendering of title-3: same size and weight, tighter line height.

styles.name: lead-en
styles.sample: This version is still ugly and I'm not sure about it myself.
styles.usage: English rendering of lead: same size and weight, tighter line height.

styles.name: body-en
styles.sample: Empty praise helps nobody. If something doesn't work, we say so.
styles.usage: English rendering of body: same size and weight, tighter line height.

styles.name: body-strong-en
styles.usage: English rendering of body-strong: same size and weight, tighter line height.

styles.name: small-en
styles.usage: English rendering of small: same size and weight, tighter line height.

styles.name: label-en
styles.usage: English rendering of label: same size and weight, tighter line height.

tokens.name: spacing-1
tokens.usage: Icon to its label inside a chip; hairline gaps.

tokens.name: spacing-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, between a label and its control.

tokens.name: spacing-3
tokens.usage: Input inline padding; gap inside a byline row.

tokens.name: spacing-4
tokens.usage: Minimum page gutter on phones; button inline padding; stack gap inside a card.

tokens.name: spacing-5
tokens.usage: Card and post padding on phones.

tokens.name: spacing-6
tokens.usage: Card and post padding from 640px; page gutter from 640px; gap between cards.

tokens.name: spacing-8
tokens.usage: Gap between timeline entries; between page sections on phones.

tokens.name: spacing-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections from 640px.

tokens.name: spacing-16
tokens.usage: Above the footer; around the home hero.

tokens.name: spacing-24
tokens.usage: Top of the sign-in column on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, chips, badges, the highlighter mark.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, posts, feedback items, state panels, menus.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Initials avatars and timeline dots only.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Optional lift for a sheet on paper. Cards rely on color-rule first; use this at most on the post being read.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Things that float over the page: the member menu, the mobile nav sheet, dialogs.
